question: According to the Public Affairs Index 2020, which among the following has been adjudged the best governed union territory in the category of UTs?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Chandigarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Chandigarh ranked** first among Union Territories**
 
• **Kerala** ranked first among **large states**
 
• **Uterpardesh** is the **wors**t performer state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Public affairs index**

 
 
• Public Affairs Centre –** Not-for-Profit Organization** (NPO) **based in Bengaluru (Karnataka**)
 
• In this index, PAC has released the ranking of states on the basis of** three important pillars** of governance
 
• growth, equity and sustainability
 
• **Established in 1994 **with a mandate to improve the quality of governance in India
 
• There are **10 themes in the Public Affairs Index**
 
 
• **​​**Essential Infrastructure
 
• Support to Human Development
 
• Social Protection
 
• Child and Women
 
• Crime, Law and Order
 
• Delivery of Justice
 
• Environment
 
• Transparency And Accountability 
 
• Fiscal Management and
 
• Economic Freedom.
 
 
 
 

a2
